## Item Cycler

Allows cycling through items.

* Wii Wheel: Not supported.
* Nunchuk: Press `D-Pad Left/Right` to cycle through items.
* Classic Controller/GameCube Controller: Hold `Y` and press `D-Pad Left/Right` to cycle through items.

Cycling to "No Item" clears your current item.

There are two versions of the code:

## Debug

Recreation of the Debug Item Cycler feature from the Mario Kart 8/Deluxe debug build. Press the item use button to give yourself the last item cycled to. No item will be given if you've never cycled or if the last item cycled to is "No Item".
